# Missing ratings: simulation (generated by scripts/sim_missing.py)

2000 items, 30 binary raters, prevalence 0.3, sensitivity and specificity uniform on [0.55, 0.85], conditional independence. Accuracy against the true label, mean over 5 seeds. Ratings per item = 30 x observed rate. 'Param. error' = mean |estimated - true| sensitivity/specificity of the verifiers FUSE kept.

## Assignment: random

| 5% | 68.2 | 72.7 | 30.4 | 66.9 | 66.6 | 64.1 | 0.449 | 0.208 |
